description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Avalore.ai is hiring an Infrastructure Engineer to design, engineer, and integrate the infrastructure supporting the WDP System. The role manages cloud environments, networks, storage, logging, auditing, and DevSecOps pipelines while improving platform security, scalability, resilience, performance, and cost-efficiency.
Cloud infrastructure architect for IaC, DevSecOps pipelines, monitoring, and disaster recovery

Responsibilities:
• Design, engineer, and integrate the underlying infrastructure of the WDP System
• Manage the cloud environment, network, data storage, logging and auditing functions, and DevSecOps pipelines
• Focus on the continuous improvement of the platform's core infrastructure to ensure it is secure, scalable, and resilient
• Architect and implement cloud-based infrastructure solutions
• Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code practices
• Design high-availability and disaster recovery solutions
• Optimize infrastructure performance and cost-efficiency
• Implement monitoring and alerting systems to ensure infrastructure health
• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues
• Collaborate with security teams to implement infrastructure security controls
• Stay current with cloud service provider offerings and best practices
• Mentor junior infrastructure team members

Requirements:
• SECRET Security Clearance Required
• Junior: 0 - 3 years of experience + Bachelor's Degree
• Journeyman: 4 - 7 years of experience + Bachelor's Degree
• Senior: 8+ years of experience + Bachelor's Degree
• Good communication skills, self-starter mindset
• Professional proficiency in English is required
• Demonstrated proficiency in using all Microsoft Office applications
• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Avalore will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position
• Moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone and printers) and /or occasional Loud noise (airfield, large equipment)
• Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time
• While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to sit, stand, talk, and hear
• Employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers to operate a computer
• Up to 10%/ Occasional travel

Preferred:
• Cloud+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+, or SSCP certification (Junior / Journeyman roles)
• SecurityX / CASP+, CCNP Security, CCSP, FITSP-O, or GFACT certification (for Senior roles)
